questions.q: How many surahs are in the Quran?
questions.explain: The Quran contains 114 surahs in total.

questions.q: Which is the first surah of the Quran?
questions.explain: Al-Fatiha (The Opening) is the first surah.

questions.q: Which is the longest surah of the Quran?
questions.explain: Al-Baqarah has 286 verses — the longest surah.

questions.q: Which is the shortest surah of the Quran?
questions.explain: Al-Kawthar has only 3 verses.

questions.q: Which surah does not begin with Bismillah?
questions.explain: Surah At-Tawbah is the only surah without Bismillah at its start.

questions.q: What was the first word revealed of the Quran?
questions.explain: The first revealed word was 'Iqra' — 'Read' — from Surah Al-Alaq.

questions.q: How many Juz is the Quran divided into?
questions.explain: The Quran is divided into 30 Juz (parts).

questions.q: Which surah is recited in every rak'ah of prayer?
questions.explain: Al-Fatiha is recited in every rak'ah of every prayer.

questions.q: Which surah is called the 'Heart of the Quran'?
questions.explain: The Prophet ﷺ referred to Ya-Sin as the heart of the Quran.

questions.q: Which surah of the Quran is named after a woman?
questions.explain: Surah Maryam is the only surah named after a woman.

questions.q: Which surah of the Quran is named after an insect?
questions.explain: An-Nahl means 'The Bee'.

questions.q: In which surah is Ayat al-Kursi found?
questions.explain: Ayat al-Kursi is verse 255 of Surah Al-Baqarah.

questions.q: In which month was the Quran first revealed?
questions.explain: The Quran was first revealed in Ramadan (Al-Baqarah 2:185).

questions.q: Which prophet is mentioned the most times in the Quran?
questions.explain: Musa (a.s) is mentioned more than any other prophet.

questions.q: Which surah is called the 'Bride of the Quran'?
questions.explain: Surah Ar-Rahman is often called 'Arus al-Quran' — the Bride of the Quran.

questions.q: Which surah begins with 'Qul Huwallahu Ahad'?
questions.explain: Al-Ikhlas is the surah of pure monotheism.

questions.q: How many years did the Quran take to be revealed?
questions.explain: The Quran was revealed over 23 years (13 in Makkah, 10 in Madinah).

questions.q: Which surah of the Quran contains two Bismillahs?
questions.explain: Surah An-Naml contains Bismillah in the middle (27:30) besides its opening.

questions.q: Which surah is called 'Umm al-Kitab' (Mother of the Book)?
questions.explain: Al-Fatiha is called Umm al-Kitab, the Mother of the Book.

questions.q: Which surah contains the longest verse in the Quran?
questions.explain: Al-Baqarah 2:282 (the verse of debt) is the longest verse.

questions.q: Which two surahs are known as 'az-Zahrawan' (the two lights)?
questions.explain: The Prophet ﷺ called Al-Baqarah and Aal-i-Imraan 'az-Zahrawan' — the two lights.

questions.q: How many verses (ayahs) are in the Quran?
questions.explain: The Quran has 6,236 verses.

questions.q: Which surah was the last to be revealed in full?
questions.explain: Surah An-Nasr is widely regarded as the last complete surah revealed.

questions.q: Which angel conveyed the Quran to the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.explain: Angel Jibril (a.s) conveyed the revelation to the Prophet ﷺ.

questions.q: How many surahs were revealed in Makkah (Makkan)?
questions.explain: 86 surahs are Makkan; 28 are Madinan.

questions.q: Who was the first prophet?
questions.explain: Adam (a.s) was the first human and the first prophet.

questions.q: Who built the ark?
questions.explain: Nuh (a.s) built the ark as commanded by Allah.

questions.q: Which prophet was thrown into a fire that became cool?
questions.explain: Ibrahim (a.s) was thrown into the fire by Nimrod, but Allah made it cool and safe.

questions.q: Which prophet was swallowed by a whale?
questions.explain: Yunus (a.s) was swallowed by a great fish.

questions.q: Who was called 'Kalimullah' — the one who spoke to Allah?
questions.explain: Musa (a.s) spoke directly to Allah — hence Kalimullah.

questions.q: Who was the last prophet?
questions.explain: Muhammad ﷺ is the final Messenger of Allah.

questions.q: Which prophet had 12 sons?
questions.explain: Yaqub (a.s) — also known as Israel — had 12 sons.

questions.q: Which prophet was given the Zabur (Psalms)?
questions.explain: Dawud (a.s) was given the Zabur.

questions.q: Which father and son built the Kaaba?
questions.explain: Ibrahim (a.s) and his son Ismail (a.s) rebuilt the Kaaba.

questions.q: Who is called the 'father of the prophets'?
questions.explain: Ibrahim (a.s) is called Abu al-Anbiya — the father of the prophets.

questions.q: Which prophet is famous for his patience?
questions.explain: Ayyub (a.s) is the model of patience in the face of trial.

questions.q: Who was the king-prophet given control over the wind and jinn?
questions.explain: Sulayman (a.s) was given command over wind, jinn, and animals.

questions.q: Which prophet could heal the blind and the leper by Allah's permission?
questions.explain: Isa (a.s) healed the blind and leper by Allah's permission.

questions.q: Which prophet is called 'Khalilullah' — the friend of Allah?
questions.explain: Ibrahim (a.s) is called Khalilullah, the close friend of Allah.

questions.q: Which prophet was raised to the heavens without dying?
questions.explain: Isa (a.s) was raised to the heavens and will return before the Day of Judgement.

questions.q: Whose dream did Yusuf (a.s) interpret for the king of Egypt?
options: Seven cows and seven ears of corn
questions.explain: Yusuf (a.s) interpreted the dream of seven fat and seven lean cows — meaning seven years of plenty followed by famine.

questions.q: Which prophet was a shepherd and spoke from the cradle?
questions.explain: Isa (a.s) spoke from the cradle as a newborn.

questions.q: How many prophets are mentioned by name in the Quran?
questions.explain: 25 prophets are mentioned by name in the Quran.

questions.q: Which prophet's people were destroyed by a rain of stones?
questions.explain: The people of Lut (a.s) were destroyed by a shower of stones.

questions.q: What was the name of Musa's (a.s) brother who was also a prophet?
questions.explain: Harun (a.s) was Musa's (a.s) brother and assisted him in his mission.

questions.q: Which prophet's people were destroyed by a violent wind?
questions.explain: The people of 'Ad, to whom Hud (a.s) was sent, were destroyed by a barren wind.

questions.q: Which prophet was given the title 'Dhul-Kifl'?
questions.explain: Dhul-Kifl (a.s) is mentioned by this title in the Quran.

questions.q: Which prophet had a staff that turned into a serpent?
questions.explain: Musa's (a.s) staff turned into a serpent by Allah's command.

questions.q: Which prophet was cast into a well by his brothers?
questions.explain: Yusuf (a.s) was thrown into a well by his jealous brothers.

questions.q: Which prophet's father was also a prophet?
questions.explain: Yahya (a.s) was the son of Zakariyya (a.s), both prophets.

questions.q: In which city was the Prophet ﷺ born?
questions.explain: The Prophet ﷺ was born in Makkah in 570 CE.

questions.q: Who was the mother of the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.explain: Aminah bint Wahb was the Prophet's ﷺ mother.

questions.q: Who was the father of the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.explain: Abdullah ibn Abdul-Muttalib was the Prophet's ﷺ father, who died before his birth.

questions.q: Who was the first wife of the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.explain: Khadijah (RA) was the first wife and the first Muslim.

questions.q: At what age did the Prophet ﷺ receive the first revelation?
questions.explain: The Prophet ﷺ was 40 years old at the first revelation.

questions.q: Where did the Prophet ﷺ receive the first revelation?
questions.explain: The first revelation came in the Cave of Hira on Jabal an-Nur.

questions.q: Which angel brought the revelation to the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.explain: Angel Jibril (a.s) brought the revelation.

questions.q: To which city did the Prophet ﷺ migrate during the Hijrah?
questions.explain: The Prophet ﷺ migrated from Makkah to Madinah.

questions.q: Which year is year 1 of the Islamic calendar?
questions.explain: Year 1 AH corresponds to 622 CE, the year of the Hijrah.

questions.q: Which battle was fought in 2 AH?
questions.explain: The Battle of Badr took place in Ramadan of 2 AH.

questions.q: How many Muslims fought at the Battle of Badr?
questions.explain: 313 Muslims faced over 1,000 Quraysh at Badr.

questions.q: Which uncle of the Prophet ﷺ protected him in Makkah?
questions.explain: Abu Talib was the Prophet's ﷺ uncle who protected him for years.

questions.q: Which uncle was called the 'Lion of Allah'?
questions.explain: Hamza (RA), the Prophet's ﷺ uncle, was called Asadullah — the Lion of Allah.

questions.q: In which cave did the Prophet ﷺ hide during the Hijrah?
questions.explain: The Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr hid in the Cave of Thawr for three days.

questions.q: Who accompanied the Prophet ﷺ on the Hijrah?
questions.explain: Abu Bakr (RA) accompanied the Prophet ﷺ on the Hijrah.

questions.q: How many years did the Prophet ﷺ live in Madinah?
questions.explain: The Prophet ﷺ lived in Madinah for about 10 years.

questions.q: Which battle is called the 'Day of Distinction' (Yawm al-Furqan)?
questions.explain: Badr is called Yawm al-Furqan — the day of distinction between truth and falsehood.

questions.q: Which treaty lasted for 10 years?
questions.explain: The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah was agreed to last 10 years.

questions.q: In which year did the Conquest of Makkah take place?
questions.explain: The Conquest of Makkah took place in 8 AH (630 CE).

questions.q: What was the full name of the Prophet's ﷺ mother?
questions.explain: Aminah bint Wahb was the Prophet's ﷺ mother.

questions.q: How many years did the Prophet ﷺ live in total?
questions.explain: The Prophet ﷺ lived for 63 years.

questions.q: Who was the first person to accept Islam?
questions.explain: Khadijah (RA) was the first person to accept Islam.

questions.q: Which battle did the Prophet ﷺ participate in while wounded?
questions.explain: At Uhud, the Prophet ﷺ was wounded — his face cut and tooth chipped.

questions.q: How many years did the Prophet ﷺ preach in Makkah?
questions.explain: The Prophet ﷺ preached in Makkah for 13 years before the Hijrah.

questions.q: Which is the only Hajj the Prophet ﷺ performed after the Hijrah?
questions.explain: The Farewell Pilgrimage in 10 AH was the only Hajj he performed after the Hijrah.

questions.q: Who was the first Caliph of Islam?
questions.explain: Abu Bakr as-Siddiq (RA) was the first Caliph.

questions.q: Who was the second Caliph of Islam?
questions.explain: Umar ibn al-Khattab (RA) was the second Caliph.

questions.q: Who was the third Caliph of Islam?
questions.explain: Uthman ibn Affan (RA) was the third Caliph.

questions.q: Who was the fourth Caliph of Islam?
questions.explain: Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA) was the fourth Caliph.

questions.q: Who was the first muezzin (caller to prayer) of Islam?
questions.explain: Bilal ibn Rabah (RA) was the first muezzin.

questions.q: What was the title of Abu Bakr (RA)?
questions.explain: Abu Bakr (RA) was called As-Siddiq — the truthful.

questions.q: Which companion was known as the 'Lion of Allah'?
questions.explain: Hamza ibn Abdul-Muttalib (RA) was called Asadullah — the Lion of Allah.

questions.q: Which companion was called 'Sayfullah' — the Sword of Allah?
questions.explain: Khalid ibn al-Walid (RA) was called Sayfullah.

questions.q: Which companion was known as 'Al-Farooq'?
questions.explain: Umar (RA) was called Al-Farooq — the one who distinguishes truth from falsehood.

questions.q: What was the title of Uthman (RA)?
questions.explain: Uthman (RA) was called Dhun-Nurayn — the possessor of two lights.

questions.q: Who was the governor that had once been a slave?
questions.explain: Salman al-Farsi (RA) became governor of Mada'in.

questions.q: Which companion preserved the most hadith?
questions.explain: Abu Hurayrah (RA) narrated over 5,000 hadith — more than any other companion.

questions.q: Who freed Bilal (RA) from slavery?
questions.explain: Abu Bakr (RA) purchased and freed Bilal (RA).

questions.q: Who was the adopted son of the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.explain: Zayd ibn Harithah (RA) was raised as the Prophet's ﷺ adopted son.

questions.q: Which companion was known for purchasing the Well of Rumah?
questions.explain: Uthman (RA) purchased the Well of Rumah and made it free for all Muslims.

questions.q: Who was the Prophet's ﷺ disciple (hawari)?
questions.explain: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Every prophet has a disciple — and my disciple is Zubayr.'

questions.q: Which companion was the first to shed blood for Islam?
questions.explain: Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (RA) was the first to shed blood in defence of Islam.

questions.q: Which companion is the only one named in the Quran?
questions.explain: Zayd ibn Harithah (RA) is the only companion mentioned by name in the Quran.

questions.q: How many years did Abu Bakr (RA) rule as Caliph?
questions.explain: Abu Bakr (RA) ruled for about 2 years (632–634 CE).

questions.q: Which young companion was appointed as commander of a Muslim army?
questions.explain: Usamah ibn Zayd (RA) was appointed commander at a very young age.

questions.q: Who was the scribe of the revelation who compiled the standard Quran?
questions.explain: Zayd ibn Thabit (RA) led the compilation and later standardisation of the Quran.

questions.q: How many companions were given glad tidings of Paradise in one gathering?
questions.explain: The 'Asharah Mubasharah' — 10 companions given glad tidings of Paradise.

questions.q: Who was the companion who was Aisha's (RA) father?
questions.explain: Abu Bakr (RA) was the father of Aisha (RA).

questions.q: Which companion's body shielded the Prophet ﷺ at Uhud?
questions.explain: Talha ibn Ubaydullah (RA) shielded the Prophet ﷺ with his own body at Uhud.

questions.q: Which companion was appointed governor of Mada'in (former Persian capital)?
questions.explain: Salman al-Farsi (RA) served as governor of Mada'in.

questions.q: How many pillars of Islam are there?
questions.explain: The 5 pillars of Islam: Shahada, Salah, Zakat, Sawm, Hajj.

questions.q: How many daily prayers are obligatory?
questions.explain: There are 5 obligatory daily prayers.

questions.q: How many rak'ahs are in Fajr prayer?
questions.explain: Fajr has 2 obligatory rak'ahs.

questions.q: How many rak'ahs are in Maghrib prayer?
questions.explain: Maghrib has 3 obligatory rak'ahs.

questions.q: What is the rate of Zakat on wealth?
questions.explain: Zakat is 2.5% of qualifying wealth held for one lunar year.

questions.q: Which month is fasting obligatory?
questions.explain: Fasting in Ramadan is one of the pillars of Islam.

questions.q: What do Muslims face during prayer?
questions.explain: Muslims face the Qibla — the Kaaba in Makkah.

questions.q: How many pillars of Iman (faith) are there?
questions.explain: Six pillars of Iman: belief in Allah, angels, books, messengers, the Last Day, and divine decree.

questions.q: What is the Nisab (minimum threshold) for zakat on gold?
questions.explain: The Nisab on gold is 85 grams.

questions.q: What is the Nisab for zakat on silver?
questions.explain: The Nisab on silver is 595 grams.

questions.q: How many rak'ahs are in Isha prayer?
questions.explain: Isha has 4 obligatory rak'ahs.

questions.q: How many rak'ahs are in Dhuhr prayer?
questions.explain: Dhuhr has 4 obligatory rak'ahs.

questions.q: How many rak'ahs are in Asr prayer?
questions.explain: Asr has 4 obligatory rak'ahs.

questions.q: How many obligatory acts (fard) are in wudu?
questions.explain: The four obligations of wudu: face, arms, head, and feet.

questions.q: What is the name of the Prophet's ﷺ farewell pilgrimage?
questions.explain: It is called Hajj al-Wida — the Farewell Pilgrimage.

questions.q: How many trips between Safa and Marwa are made during Sa'i?
questions.explain: Sa'i is 7 trips between Safa and Marwa.

questions.q: What is the daily Friday congregational prayer called?
questions.explain: The Friday congregational prayer is Jumu'ah.

questions.q: What is the minimum number of rak'ahs for Witr prayer?
questions.explain: Witr can be as few as 1 rak'ah.

questions.q: On which day of Dhul-Hijjah is the Day of Arafah?
questions.explain: The Day of Arafah is the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah.

questions.q: How many pebbles are thrown at each Jamarah?
questions.explain: 7 pebbles are thrown at each Jamarah.

questions.q: When is Zakat al-Fitr due?
questions.explain: Zakat al-Fitr is due before the Eid al-Fitr prayer.

questions.q: What is the ruling on combining (jama') Maghrib and Isha during travel?
questions.explain: Combining prayers is permissible for travellers.

questions.q: How many days is it recommended to fast in Shawwal?
questions.explain: Fasting 6 days in Shawwal after Eid carries the reward of a full year's fast.

questions.q: What is the minimum age of Zakat al-Fitr per person based on food weight?
questions.explain: Zakat al-Fitr is about 2.5–3 kg of staple food per person.

questions.q: What is the ruling on praying the two rak'ahs of Fajr sunnah?
questions.explain: The two sunnah rak'ahs before Fajr are highly emphasised (Sunnah Mu'akkadah).

questions.q: What is the Islamic greeting?
questions.explain: 'As-salamu alaykum' — peace be upon you.

questions.q: What is the Muslim holy day of the week?
questions.explain: Friday (Jumu'ah) is the holy day of the Muslim week.

questions.q: In which city is the Kaaba located?
questions.explain: The Kaaba is in Makkah.

questions.q: In which city is Masjid an-Nabawi?
questions.explain: Masjid an-Nabawi — the Prophet's ﷺ Mosque — is in Madinah.

questions.q: Which angel brought revelation to the prophets?
questions.explain: Jibril (a.s) is the angel of revelation.

questions.q: What is the Muslim month of fasting?
questions.explain: Ramadan is the month of obligatory fasting.

questions.q: What is the Islamic festival at the end of Ramadan called?
questions.explain: Eid al-Fitr — the festival of breaking the fast.

questions.q: What is the Islamic festival of sacrifice called?
questions.explain: Eid al-Adha — the festival of sacrifice.

questions.q: What is the first month of the Islamic (Hijri) calendar?
questions.explain: Muharram is the first month of the Hijri calendar.

questions.q: What is the name of the well near the Kaaba?
questions.explain: Zamzam is the blessed well near the Kaaba.

questions.q: What is the night journey of the Prophet ﷺ called?
questions.explain: Isra (night journey to Jerusalem) and Mi'raj (ascension to the heavens).

questions.q: What is the covering of the Kaaba called?
questions.explain: The Kaaba is covered by the Kiswah.

questions.q: What is the name of the angel who will blow the trumpet on the Last Day?
questions.explain: Israfil (a.s) will blow the trumpet signalling the Day of Judgement.

questions.q: How many names (attributes) of Allah are traditionally listed?
questions.explain: The 99 beautiful names of Allah — Asma ul-Husna.

questions.q: What is the Arabic word for Paradise?
questions.explain: Jannah is Paradise.

questions.q: What is the Arabic word for Hell?
questions.explain: Jahannam is Hell.

questions.q: What is the bridge that souls must cross on the Day of Judgement?
questions.explain: The Sirat is the bridge over Jahannam.

questions.q: What was the old name of Madinah before the Hijrah?
questions.explain: Madinah was originally called Yathrib.

questions.q: Which Christian monk recognised the signs of prophethood in the young Muhammad ﷺ?
questions.explain: The monk Bahira recognised the signs during the journey to Syria.

questions.q: What was the Prophet's ﷺ title before prophethood?
questions.explain: He was known as Al-Amin — the trustworthy.

questions.q: Which surah is recommended to recite on Fridays?
questions.explain: Reciting Surah Al-Kahf on Fridays is a recommended sunnah.

questions.q: What is the name of the Lote Tree at the boundary of the seventh heaven?
questions.explain: Sidrat al-Muntaha is the Lote Tree at the utmost boundary.

questions.q: What is the term for the intermediate state between death and resurrection?
questions.explain: Barzakh is the barrier — the state after death until resurrection.

questions.q: What is the name of the great gathering of all souls on the Day of Judgement?
questions.explain: Al-Mahshar is the place of the great gathering.

questions.q: How many years after the Hijrah did the Prophet ﷺ pass away?
questions.explain: The Prophet ﷺ passed away in 11 AH — about 10 years after the Hijrah.
